primary_source.title: Wi-Fi Access Point Design Concept Targeting Indoor Positioning for Smartphones and IoT

page_audit.evidence: The assembly description states 50-ohm coaxial cable with a U.FL connector, while the antenna assembly also uses SMA adaptors. It provides no connector dimensions.

Section 3.1 states FR-4 er=4.5, tan(delta)=0.025, h=1.5 mm; Figure 2 shows the patch, substrate, reflector, and an SMA connector; Equation (3) specifies the 50-ohm feed-location relation. No conductor, SMA, mesh, or boundary dimensions are stated.
Table 1 states only Lg, Wg=WR, LR, Lp, Wp, and Xp. Figure 3 is a plotted simulated S11 curve with no numeric data table.
The article states 'Data Availability Statement: Not applicable.' No supplementary CST project or numeric S11 dataset is identified.
